founders.founder_bio:
I am an AI technologist with a decade of experience scaling AI/ML products. At Meta and X, I specialized in leading tiger teams to launch high-stakes 0-to-1 initiatives.

Now, I am the Co-Founder of Piris Labs. We are building high-speed photonic interconnects to solve the energy and latency constraints for AI data inference. My current focus is to iterate on our inference service and onboard customers into our platform.

launches.title: Piris Labs: We Set the Fastest Reported GLM-5.2 Inference Speed
launches.tagline: Fast, scalable AI workload execution infrastructure.
launches.body:
Piris Labs  just achieved the fastest reported inference speed for the new GLM-5.2, outperforming pioneers and veterans in the space.

We finished the YC batch just a few months ago and believed it was important to maintain that same pace of execution while keeping our technical bar high. So yes, the YC advice is right: keep building.

A lean, highly passionate team with strong execution and the right long-term vision can accomplish in a short period of time what often takes much larger organizations with billions in funding and hundreds of people years to achieve.

We're well on track to build fast, scalable, and low-cost AI workload execution infrastructure with a deep focus on the data movement layer, where many of the biggest bottlenecks in performance and unit economics exist.

Read the full details here:

<https://pirislabs.io/news/glm-benchmark>

We welcome independent third-party benchmarking. Feel free to DM us or reach out by email.

launches.title: Piris Labs: Inference at Light Speed
launches.tagline: We deliver low-latency, low-cost AI inference by eliminating the memory wall using full-stack optical interconnects and a purpose-built software stack.
launches.body:
**The Problem: The Memory Wall Is Breaking the Economics of AI Compute**

AI’s promise is unprecedented, but its economics are broken. Copper-based interconnects cannot keep up with modern models, limiting data movement between and within compute and memory. The result is high latency, inefficient hardware utilization, and unsustainable inference costs—creating a hard ceiling on AI margins.

---

**The Solution: Grow-Style Optimization for the Interconnect**

Today’s data-center compute and networking were not designed for inference. Slow, power-hungry **copper** interconnects, along with costly signal processing and memory overhead, drive high latency and high cost.

High-performance inference requires purpose-built hardware and a vertically optimized software stack. Piris Labs builds this optimized stack by combining proprietary **optical** interconnects with software designed to maximize hardware utilization. We vertically optimize the interconnect layer—just as the compute layer was vertically optimized by **Groq** (acquired by **NVIDIA** for $20 B).

Piris Labs combines proprietary optical interconnects with a purpose-built software stack designed to maximize hardware utilization, delivering **5x** lower latency, **10x** lower power per bit, and **2x** lower cost per token\
\
**Our Launch Video**\
<https://youtu.be/PW1PbMYw2c0>

**The Team**

We are a team of specialists at the intersection of hardware and AI:

* Ali Khalatpour: MIT-trained engineer and Harvard–Stanford–trained optical scientist; developed the first room-temperature terahertz semiconductor laser; led the development of GUSTO’s optical engine for NASA
* Keyvan Rezaei Moghadam: AI scientist and engineering leader with experience building 0-to-1 AI infrastructure at Meta and Twitter.
